rows.proposal: R1: adopt actor/transport ownership pattern in contract; reimplement against Recursion invariants
rows.competing_option: Vendor a narrow session core, or a shared-loop service design
rows.decisive_falsifier: Under common fault corpus, control starvation, stale completion or resource cost exceeds the competing accepted implementation
rows.non_proof_and_sources: No Rust/Tokio selection or concurrency safety; [GB-SESSION] [GB-SPAWN], T03/T10

rows.proposal: R2: adopt explicit queue/steer/cancel-and-send dispositions; adapter translates wire details
rows.competing_option: Upstream-native presentation translated through the same complete canonical queue/steer/cancel dispositions
rows.decisive_falsifier: Any accepted trace loses/reorders/duplicates input, falsely reports consumption, or targets a successor turn
rows.non_proof_and_sources: No model adoption, upstream reliability or public API stability; [GB-INTERJECT] [GB-DRAIN], T01/T02

rows.proposal: R3: port declarative skill/agent metadata through R-G's translation/loss contract
rows.competing_option: Keep complete Grok host as route adapter, or native equivalents
rows.decisive_falsifier: Required semantics or authority cannot be preserved, or accepted total port cost exceeds matched native rewrite
rows.non_proof_and_sources: No universal importer or cheap-port claim; [GB-PLUGIN-MANIFEST] [GB-SKILLS], T08/T11

rows.proposal: R4: avoid hooks/path-trust as authorization boundary; retain advisory hooks behind kernel admission
rows.competing_option: Mediated declarative hooks versus qualified isolated hook executors under identical grants and final sink checks. Blind upstream trust is a negative control; a disabled profile retains the shipped hook capability
rows.decisive_falsifier: Rewritten input, hook failure or stale epoch can create an unauthorized effect; if advisory hook cannot be contained, omit that binding
rows.negative_control: Blindly inherit upstream trust without independent kernel admission and final sink checks
rows.optional_disabled_profile: May be selected at runtime; does not remove shipped hook capability

rows.proposal: R5: adopt target-explicit peek/new-dispatch and session-keyed projection patterns
rows.competing_option: Flat list plus full-screen switching, or nested dashboard tree
rows.decisive_falsifier: Matched tasks show no benefit or more wrong-target submissions, missed approvals or inaccessible controls

rows.proposal: R6: port worktree dispatch through separate workspace/session transactions
rows.competing_option: Enforced single-mutator checkout with isolated reader generations versus private clones under the same scope and source-fidelity contract
rows.decisive_falsifier: Partial creation misreports isolation, source provenance diverges, or concurrent effects leak between admitted workspaces
rows.non_proof_and_sources: No snapshot completeness or effect rollback; [GB-WORKTREE] [GB-SESSIONS], T04/T05

rows.proposal: R7: use narrow allowlisted Grok ACP adapter for optional supported subset
rows.competing_option: Reimplement native capability, or adapt whole SDK/loop
rows.decisive_falsifier: Exact required input/question/resume/authority/accounting semantics cannot be represented or independently verified
rows.non_proof_and_sources: No route/account entitlement; no replacement for native loop; [GB-ACP] [GB-QUESTION], T07/T09

rows.proposal: R8: evaluate narrow vendoring only after provenance/closure review
rows.competing_option: Native rewrite or existing independently reviewed dependency
rows.decisive_falsifier: Missing required license/provenance, unacceptable transitive/native closure or higher accepted maintenance cost
rows.non_proof_and_sources: No quality/security from Apache alone; [GB-NOTICES] [GB-TOOLS-BUILD], T11/T12

rows.proposal: R9: avoid copying encoded prompt packaging as a secrecy boundary
rows.competing_option: Plain inspectable templates or independently justified asset packaging
rows.decisive_falsifier: Any claimed confidentiality depends on in-repository reversible encoding; or encoding prevents complete provenance review
rows.non_proof_and_sources: No allegation of malice; no prompt-quality conclusion; [GB-XOR], T11

rows.proposal: R10: retain Grok Rust implementation as one FU-01 comparator, not selection
rows.competing_option: Other already-specified candidate implementations on same corpus
rows.decisive_falsifier: It fails a mandatory floor, or accepted alternative dominates declared tradeoff without violating floors
rows.non_proof_and_sources: No language win, resource saving or delivery forecast; [GB-ROOT] [GB-TOOLCHAIN], T10/T12
